To sum up, functional disability basically measures the extent of ability having been compromised to carry out basic everyday tasks or even more complex tasks required for and independent living.
The limitations may occur on account of disability in the personal sphere, in the social sphere and in the occupational sphere.
In the personal sphere it may encompass the daily activities of a person, his body function and his involvement in basis life situations.
At the societal level, it could mean difficulty in involvement and participation in social and community activities interfering the interpersonal interaction and relationship adversely impacting the civic life.
When disability restricts the vocation or employment avenues to make earning for his living, it falls in the category of disability in the occupational sphere.
The disability might occur on account of age or any illness and in the case at hand by way of an accident.
